name: world.jobo/developer
title: Jobo Developer
description: Look up Jobo company ids, occupations and filter values while you build on the Jobo jobs API.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Jobo API key, as a Bearer token. Needed by the three lookup tools (find_companies, find_filter_values, find_locations); the other tools work without it. Create a key at https://enterprise.jobo.world/api-keys.

api_key.description: A Jobo API key (starts with jbe_live_).

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the local HTTP server (default 3003).
